svg.text: Cut 40 mm of 25 x 25 x 3 angle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: two 6.5 mm holes 10 mm each side of centre, 12.5 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg: two 6 mm holes 15 mm from the heel, 14 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre, for the chain end links (M5 bolt or shackle each).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: upright leg flat on the rear face of the middle cross member,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flat leg at the bottom pointing rearward; two M6 bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hang the two 250 mm chains; they drag on the soil behind the opener

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and clear the press wheel by at least 15 mm.
